t: Python FastHTML: The Ideal Web Framework for HTMX & LLMs
s: The author advocates for consistent writing and documentation as a tool for amplified agency and personal growth, finding purpose through Ikigai. They explore the evolution of web frameworks, emphasizing the 'loveworthiness' of HTML, Python, and HTMX, and introduce FastHTML as a modern framework for building HTMX-powered applications.
sub: FastHTML as a modern web framework integrating HTML, Python, and HTMX.
The philosophy of writing and documentation as a driver for project momentum and personal growth (Ikigai).
Python's inherent 'framework-like' nature due to its powerful core data types.
The evolution and comparison of Python web frameworks (Django, Flask, Plone/Zope) and their opinionated vs. unopinionated approaches.
Leveraging Git branching for LLM-friendly code development and reducing fear in experimentation.
